home.title: hybrid-rag: ask your PDFs, check every answer
home.description: hybrid-rag answers questions about your own PDFs and shows where each answer comes from.

features.title: Features
features.description: What hybrid-rag does: cited answers, two ways of searching, groups, and tools to see where a wrong answer came from.

how-it-works.description: From PDF to answer: how hybrid-rag splits, indexes and searches documents, and why it can say it found nothing.

about.title: About hybrid-rag and its author
about.description: Who builds hybrid-rag, why it exists and how to help. An open source project by Lukasz Malicki, Poland.

faq.description: Answers about what hybrid-rag can and cannot do, where your data goes and how to run it.
